g.title: Overall TuxBox progress
g.desc: Identify a package · Verified. Native process and memory · Partial. Guest graphics submission · Partial. Retail shader and resource translation · Partial. Playable platform services · Partial. First retail title · Original settings blocked. Multi-title compatibility and performance · Pending

g.title: Frosty gameplay target
g.text: Current target · The Matrix Awakens with its packaged graphics settings

g.title: Xbox library coverage
g.text: Bars count verified exports. Empty circles mark incomplete support.

g.title: d3d12_xs.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 53/54 (98.1%). TuxBox Rust device and command providers with desktop D3D12 root-signature serialization. Two Xbox device profiles, eight feature queries, GPU heaps, guest-backed textures, queues, indirect compute, direct and indirect mesh dispatch, descriptor and query operations, and 32 identifiers. Frosty creates 680-byte mesh pipelines and 712-byte graphics pipelines through ID3D12Device2 and presents 3840 × 2160 frames. A fresh Proton prefix running the checkout-built providers displays the menu and video preview, opens Settings and enters the Wake Up sequence. GPU tests cover indexed draws, depth/stencil writes, NV12 plane copies, and whole and regional copies into a tiled RGBA8 texture with guest-memory writeback and alias readback. The framebuffer-preservation size getter matches the supplied DLL in its initial state. The Series VM configuration computes a process GPU address range for zero-preservation requests. Placed-texture GPU readbacks exercise that range, explicit CPU cache flush and memory profiling. Two private UMD operations implement record updates and final-release callbacks. The first three PIX callbacks support capture-device setup. Frosty direct imports verified 6/6. Verified (D3D12XboxCreateDevice, IID_ID3D12Device, D3D12SerializeRootSignature, D3D12SerializeVersionedRootSignature, D3D12CreateDevice, D3D12XboxSetProcessDebugFlags).

dxcompiler_xs.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 4/4 (100%). TuxBox Rust ray compiler adapter and desktop DXC. All four factories have tested behavior. Three Frosty ray-generation shaders passed shader table preparation, and the Xbox linker accepted TuxBox continuation collections for five Frosty miss shaders. Global and local root UAVs produced the expected results on a desktop GPU. Frosty direct imports verified 1/1. Verified (DxcCreateInstance).

xmem.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 32/32 (100%). TuxBox Rust CPU memory provider. All 31 functions and the history data export have tested behavior. Frosty’s physical-page reservations share writable 64 KiB pages across virtual addresses. Tests cover partition accounting, heaps, pools, virtual queries, allocation tags, write-watch, scatter mapping, history and the seven HTTP callbacks. Frosty direct imports verified 9/9. Verified (XMemAlloc, XMemGetWorkingSetStatistics, XMemAllocatePhysicalPages, XMemMapPhysicalPages, XMemFreePhysicalPages, XMemFree, XMemFreeDefault, XMemAllocDefault, XMemVirtualAlloc).

xg_xs.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 21/21 (100%). TuxBox texture address computer. All 21 exports and all 13 texture-computer methods have tested behavior. TuxBox matched the full layout and sampled addresses of all 1,760 distinct Frosty descriptors captured through frame two. DCC checks cross-decoded 205,920 blocks across 45 formats. Frosty direct imports verified 1/1. Verified (XGCreateTextureComputer).

xgameruntime.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 4/5 (80%). TuxBox Xbox Game Runtime with Rust task queues. TuxBox implements runtime initialization, threading-interface queries and queues. The guest checks manual, threadpool, serialized and immediate dispatch, cancellation and termination. No static PE import path found.

xcrdapi.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 1/118 (0.8%). TuxBox Rust storage queues over Windows file handles, with Rust zlib decompression. Frosty’s storage factory opens files and reads queue entries into game memory. Isolated guests decoded two 64 KiB blocks directly from its retail container on two Proton builds. Frosty direct imports verified 1/1. Verified (DStorageGetFactory).

GameInput.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 1/1 (100%). TuxBox GameInput v0 provider for polling and device status callbacks. Lanes reads keyboard, mouse and XInput state through ordinal 1. TuxBox handles the blocking device enumeration requested by Frosty. With keyboard-to-gamepad enabled, all 48 tested key edges, mouse confirmation and signed mouse-look reached the gamepad reading. Frosty direct imports verified 1/1. Verified (#1).

AcpHal.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 0/10 (0%). TuxBox Rust AcpHal provider; runtime validation pending. The Rust provider builds seven of Frosty's imported exports: the host-backed APU heap, XMA context allocation, inert IAcpHal object, and release entry point. The earlier reference-provider trial started the mixer; TuxBox behavior remains unverified. Frosty direct imports verified 0/7. Unverified (AcpHalReleaseShapeContexts, AcpHalAllocateShapeContexts, AcpHalCreate, ApuAlloc, ApuFree, ApuHeapGetState, ApuCreateHeap).

XAudio2_9.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 8/10 (80%). TuxBox Xbox ordinal exports backed by system XAudio2. Eight exports cover all five static imports in Frosty. The guest creates engines through all three tested factory ordinals, instantiates three effects, pans a source and measures the signal on each stereo channel. Frosty direct imports verified 5/5. Verified (#2, #1, #4, #5, #6).

GameChat2.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 13/70 (18.6%). TuxBox Rust chat session, user roster and outgoing frame provider. Thirteen exports cover sessions, encoding bitrate, remote users, user context and outgoing endpoint announcements. Nine are among Frosty’s 15 delay imports. The guest checks payloads, endpoint IDs and borrowed frame lifetimes against the packaged DLL. Frosty direct imports verified 9/15. Verified (ChatManagerInitialize, ChatManagerCleanup, ChatManagerSetAudioEncodingBitrate, ChatManagerStartProcessingDataFrames, ChatManagerFinishProcessingDataFrames, ChatManagerAddRemoteUser, ChatManagerRemoveUser, ChatManagerGetChatUsers, ChatUserGetIsLocal). Unverified (GameChatFailFastWithInform, ChatManagerAddLocalUser, ChatManagerProcessIncomingPacket, ChatUserSetMicrophoneMuted, ChatUserGetRemoteUserMuted, ChatUserSetRemoteUserMuted).

mfplat.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 2/140 (1.4%). TuxBox DXGI device bridge and Proton Media Foundation. GPU readback verifies the Xbox device-manager reset and surface buffer. The packaged video decoders matched FFmpeg on both NV12 planes. Frosty direct imports verified 1/13. Verified (MFResetDXGIDeviceManagerX). Unverified (MFShutdown, MFCreateAlignedMemoryBuffer, MFCreateMediaType, MFCreateSample, MFStartup, MFCreateDXGIDeviceManager, MFTEnumEx, MFCreateAttributes, MFCreateMemoryBuffer, MFCreateFile, MFllMulDiv, MFCreateWaveFormatExFromMFMediaType).

mfhevcdec.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 0/5 (0%). TuxBox transform adapter around the supplied HEVC decoder. The adapter delivers synchronized D3D12 NV12 samples. Original intro and chase footage passed decoded-frame comparisons. No static PE import path found.

mfh264dec.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 1/1 (100%). TuxBox transform adapter around the supplied H.264 decoder. The registered H.264 transform returns D3D12 samples for both 1024 × 512 menu previews. No static PE import path found.

mfreadwrite.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 2/7 (28.6%). TuxBox synchronous PCM source reader. Opens seekable PCM RIFF/WAVE streams, Windows file paths and escaped file URLs. The guest compares 2,501 stereo frames and checks stream selection, seeking, timestamps, end of stream and invalid inputs. Frosty direct imports verified 1/1. Verified (MFCreateSourceReaderFromByteStream).

MSAudDecMFT.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 2/2 (100%). TuxBox AAC transform adapter using GE-Proton's host decoder. Handles the first format change and end-of-stream drain. On GE-Proton the guest decoded 25 generated and 96 Frosty AAC-LC packets into 48 kHz six-channel PCM. Each channel was compared with FFmpeg. No static PE import path found.
